# Tavren

> Tavren publishes structured AI toolkits that help in-house SAP teams prepare for the move from ECC to S/4HANA, reducing reliance on external consultants. Each toolkit is a set of structured prompts you run in your own AI tool to produce repeatable, decision-ready outputs for a specific business function — Finance, Sales, Supply Chain or HR. Individual packs are $779 and full series bundles are $3,099 (USD); a starter kit is free. Tavren is a trading name of VBCJ Solutions Ltd, registered in England and Wales. Your company data stays yours — you run the prompts in your own AI tool and Tavren never sees, stores or receives it. Checkout is handled by Lemon Squeezy as Merchant of Record.

## Key pages
- [Toolkits](https://tavrensolutions.com/toolkits): The four function-specific series, individual packs and series bundles, with pricing.
- [How it works](https://tavrensolutions.com/how-it-works): What a toolkit is, why structured prompting works, and how you run one.
- [Free starter toolkit](https://tavrensolutions.com/free-kit): A free, structured prompt set to try the format before buying.
- [FAQ](https://tavrensolutions.com/faq): Common questions about the toolkits, pricing, data privacy and delivery.
- [About](https://tavrensolutions.com/about): What Tavren is and how it works.
- [Contact](https://tavrensolutions.com/contact): Get in touch.

## Toolkit series
- Finance Director Series (Finance): Structured toolkits that help finance teams carry readiness, reporting and testing work in-house — work that would otherwise sit on a consultancy invoice.
- Sales Director Series (Sales): Toolkits that give sales and commercial teams a structured path through readiness, data, order-to-cash and go-live — without leaning on external billable hours.
- Supply Chain Series (Supply Chain): Toolkits for procurement and supply-chain leaders — readiness, sourcing, risk and spend analysis structured so your own team can do the heavy lifting.
- HR Director Series (HR): Toolkits for HR and people leaders — workforce readiness, change, organisation design and retention, structured to keep adoption and capability on track through the upgrade.
